svg.text: onda, Cmajor and YDSP against the best Faust build
Speed relative to the fastest Faust build of the same contract (the ×1 line): up, faster than Faust; down, slower. Log scale.
Strict IEEEgeometric means: onda ×0.96 · Cmajor ×0.72 · YDSP ×0.65
Cmajor: the faster of its generated C++ (clang) and its LLVM JIT. YDSP: YUP's JIT, strict or fastMath. ns per sample, Apple M5,
f32, 48 kHz, 256-frame blocks; means over 38 programs. Programs grouped by category; columns past ×⅛ are cut at the axis.
